evidence: Opened Fields dialog, added new field "Notes" with type Number; field appeared as new column "Notes" in table. Existing fields Task Name(Text), Priority(Number), Due Date(Date), Completed(Checkbox) confirm all four types supported.

issue: Missing required-field validation on Add Entry
actual: Clicked "Add Entry" with the Task Name field left blank (all other fields at default values). The app accepted the submission and created a new row with an empty Task Name cell instead of blocking submission, so an entry was added despite a field being undefined.
Clicked the delete (trash) icon on a table row. The entry was removed immediately (entry count dropped from 6 to 5) with no confirmation dialog or button appearing to confirm the deletion.

evidence: Priority field is rendered as a native input[type=number]. Attempting to type "abc" into it via Playwright failed with error "Cannot type text into input[type=number]", confirming non-numeric characters are rejected by the field.

Due Date field is a native input[type=date]. Programmatically setting its value to an invalid date "2026-13-45" resulted in the value being rejected (input.value became ""), confirming invalid dates are not accepted.

Filled Add Entry form with Task Name="QA Test Entry Alpha", Priority=7, Due Date=2026-10-15, Completed=Yes, Notes=42, submitted, and new row appeared in table with all values correctly saved. Entry count increased from 5 to 6.
New entry row shows "QA Test Entry Alpha" (text), "7" (number), "Oct 15, 2026" (date), checked checkbox icon, "42" (number) - all field types stored and displayed the input data correctly.

DOM inspection shows checked entries render a green check icon (class "lucide-check text-success") while unchecked entries render a gray X icon (class "lucide-x text-muted-foreground"), visually distinguishable.

Clicked "Cards" button; view switched from table to a grid of cards, each showing the entry title as heading and all fields (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) below. Table button remains to switch back.

All 6 entries with all 5 fields (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) are fully displayed in both Table view (columns) and Card view (per-card field list), including the newly added "QA Test Entry Alpha" entry with correct values in both views.

Each field in card view shows a text label (e.g. "Priority", "Due Date") plus a type-specific icon (hash icon for Number, calendar icon for Date, check/x icon for Checkbox). Table view column headers likewise show field names, and Configure Fields dialog shows a type icon + type name dropdown per field.

Opened Sort menu (fields: Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes), selected "Priority". Cards reordered to ascending Priority: 1,1,2,2,3,7 and status text showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)".
Clicking a sort field in the Sort menu immediately re-ordered the visible cards and updated the status text to "Sorted by Priority (ascending)" with no perceptible delay.

After sorting by Priority ascending, all 6 entries' field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) remained identical to their pre-sort values, only reordered; no data was altered or lost.
Typed "marketing" into the Search entries box; table immediately narrowed to only the "Review marketing materials" row, and status text updated to "1 entry matching \"marketing\"".

actual: Inspected the entire UI (header controls, table column headers, card view) and the full DOM for any filter control (dropdown, criteria builder, per-field filter icon, etc.). Only a free-text Search box and a Sort menu exist; there is no way to apply a filter (e.g., by numeric range, checkbox status, or exact field value) distinct from the plain text search.

issue: No filter feature to verify accuracy
actual: Since no filter control exists in the application (only text search and sort), filter accuracy/inclusion-exclusion behavior described in CS-12 cannot be exercised or verified; the requirement is unimplemented.

evidence: Used keyboard drag (focus handle, Space to pick up, 2x ArrowDown, Space to drop) on "Design new landing page" row. It moved from position 1 to position 3 exactly as operated, new order: Review marketing materials, Update API documentation, Design new landing page, Prepare quarterly report, Team sync meeting notes, QA Test Entry Alpha - matching the manual operation, with all field values preserved.
